title: Sigma and pi in propyne
statement:
How many sigma and pi bonds does CH₃–C≡CH have?

[_]{a}

explanations: Four C–H and two C–C sigma connections plus two pi components.
A triple bond adds two pi interactions.

hints: The two adjacent carbon pairs each contribute one sigma bond.
The triple bond contributes two pi bonds.
solution: Four C–H bonds are present. The two adjacent carbon pairs each contribute one sigma bond. The triple bond contributes two pi bonds. Four C–H and two C–C sigma connections plus two pi components.
